title: jig project
description: A DIY build: materials, tools, parts and steps. Lengths use the project units (mm or in).

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor help. The engine ignores it.

jig.description: Format version. This engine reads format 1.

id.description: Output file name and browser storage key. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens.

summary.description: One or two STE descriptive sentences about the object.

level.description: Level the page opens at: new (first time), some (some experience) or pro.

units.description: Unit of every length in this file: sizes, positions, stock, kerf, trim, fasteners.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD, EUR, INR.

rate.description: Tax rate as a share from 0 to 1: 7% is 0.07, 20% is 0.2.

label.description: Name of the tax, for example "VAT".

included.description: true: prices include the tax. false: the tax is added to the total.

estimate.description: true: rates show an est badge unless a material or tool sets est to false.

kerf.description: Saw cut width, at most 10 mm. Default: 3 mm, or 1/8 in when units is in.

trim.description: Waste cut from the start of each board to square the factory end. The first piece starts at trim.

contingency.description: Spare budget as a share from 0 to 0.5: 10% is 0.1.

terms.description: Technical names the STE linter accepts.

verbs.description: Extra command verbs the STE linter accepts (trade verbs).

stores.description: Where to buy. Key: store id.

materials.description: What is bought and used. Key: material id.

parts.description: What is cut, made or installed.

props.description: Context boxes (wall, bench, floor). Shown in 3D, never bought. Key: prop id.

techniques.description: Extra technique cards, or cards that replace a built-in card. Key: technique id.

steps.description: The build sequence. The plan, check and build commands need it.

uses.description: Project-wide consumables not tied to a step: { materialId: amount }.

finish.description: Project-wide finishes not tied to a step.

handoff.description: Work this guide leaves to a professional.

items.description: Work this guide leaves to a professional.

topic.description: The hand-off topic id: gas, mains, structural, height, permit, asbestos or lead-paint, for example "mains". Common names such as "mains wiring" also match.

text.description: What the professional does, in STE descriptive sentences.

tipRatio.description: Height-to-depth ratio above which an object 600 mm (24 in) tall or more needs an anchor step. A smaller object gets the warning W_TIP_SMALL.

cleared.description: Hits of the hand-off screen that are not hand-off work. An entry turns the E_HANDOFF of its topic into the info I_HANDOFF_CLEARED, and the safety review lists each hit. Never use it for real hand-off work.

items.description: A hit of the hand-off screen that is not hand-off work.

topic.description: The hand-off topic id of the hit: gas, mains, structural, height, permit, asbestos or lead-paint. Common names such as "mains wiring" also match.

why.description: Why the hit is not that work, in STE descriptive sentences, 10 to 240 characters. For lead-paint, give the age of the paint.

id.description: An id: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', 64 characters or fewer.

size3.description: Box size [x, y, z] in project units.

additionalProperties.description: Amount in the material's unit (pieces for each materials).

warn.description: A WARNING (risk of injury) or CAUTION (risk of damage), shown before the instructions.

type.description: warning: risk of injury. caution: risk of damage.

text.description: The warning in STE: the command first, then the risk.

online.description: true: an online order, put first in the purchase plan.

material.description: A material. kind sets the other fields: linear, sheet, each, amount or printed.

linear.description: A material sold by length (boards, battens, rods). Give stock (board lengths) or perLength (cut-to-size price).

name.description: Name in the BOQ and the shopping list, for example "Pine board".

kind.description: linear: sold by length (boards, battens, rods).

spec.description: Size or grade as the store writes it, for example "19 x 235 mm (1x10)".

store.description: Id of the store in stores where you buy it.

color.description: Color in the 3D view and the cut drawings.

group.description: BOQ group name. Default: from the kind (Timber and sheet, Printing, Hardware, Consumables, Finish).

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote. Default: the project estimate value.

note.description: Note shown next to the item in the shopping list.

role.description: anchor: wall fixings. A tall object needs one to pass the tip-over check.

profile.description: Section shape: rect or round (dowel, rod, pipe).

perLength.description: Cut-to-size pricing: price per length, boards up to max.

per.description: Length the price is for, in project units.

max.description: Longest board the store cuts, in project units.

step.description: Lengths are sold in steps of this size. Default: per.

sheet.description: A material sold as sheets: plywood, MDF, board.

name.description: Name in the BOQ and the shopping list, for example "Pine board".

spec.description: Size or grade as the store writes it, for example "19 x 235 mm (1x10)".

store.description: Id of the store in stores where you buy it.

color.description: Color in the 3D view and the cut drawings.

group.description: BOQ group name. Default: from the kind (Timber and sheet, Printing, Hardware, Consumables, Finish).

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote. Default: the project estimate value.

note.description: Note shown next to the item in the shopping list.

role.description: anchor: wall fixings. A tall object needs one to pass the tip-over check.

grain.description: true: pieces keep their long side along the sheet's long side.

each.description: A material counted in pieces: screws, hinges, brackets.

name.description: Name in the BOQ and the shopping list, for example "Pine board".

kind.description: each: counted in pieces (screws, hinges, brackets).

spec.description: Size or grade as the store writes it, for example "19 x 235 mm (1x10)".

store.description: Id of the store in stores where you buy it.

color.description: Color in the 3D view and the cut drawings.

group.description: BOQ group name. Default: from the kind (Timber and sheet, Printing, Hardware, Consumables, Finish).

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote. Default: the project estimate value.

note.description: Note shown next to the item in the shopping list.

role.description: anchor: wall fixings. A tall object needs one to pass the tip-over check.

packName.description: Name of one pack, for example "237 ml bottle".

price.description: Price of one pack in the project currency.

unit.description: Word for one piece, for example "piece" or "sheet".

spare.description: Spare share from 0 to 1. Default: 0.1 for fasteners, else 0.

head.description: Fastener head: flat (countersunk), pan or hex.

included.description: true: comes in a kit, listed as "in the kit" and not bought.

amount.description: A material measured by amount: glue, finish, sandpaper by the sheet.

name.description: Name in the BOQ and the shopping list, for example "Pine board".

kind.description: amount: measured in a unit (L, ml, kg, g, m, roll).

spec.description: Size or grade as the store writes it, for example "19 x 235 mm (1x10)".

store.description: Id of the store in stores where you buy it.

color.description: Color in the 3D view and the cut drawings.

group.description: BOQ group name. Default: from the kind (Timber and sheet, Printing, Hardware, Consumables, Finish).

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote. Default: the project estimate value.

note.description: Note shown next to the item in the shopping list.

role.description: anchor: wall fixings. A tall object needs one to pass the tip-over check.

pack.description: Amount in one pack, in unit.

packName.description: Name of one pack, for example "237 ml bottle".

price.description: Price of one pack in the project currency.

unit.description: Unit of the amount: L, ml, kg, g, sheet, m, roll.

coverage.description: Area one unit covers: m² for mm projects, ft² for in projects. Required for a finish.

spare.description: Spare share from 0 to 1. Default: 0.1 for finishes, else 0.

printed.description: A filament for 3D-printed parts, sold by the spool.

name.description: Name in the BOQ and the shopping list, for example "Pine board".

kind.description: printed: filament for 3D-printed parts, sold by the spool.

spec.description: Size or grade as the store writes it, for example "19 x 235 mm (1x10)".

store.description: Id of the store in stores where you buy it.

color.description: Color in the 3D view and the cut drawings.

group.description: BOQ group name. Default: from the kind (Timber and sheet, Printing, Hardware, Consumables, Finish).

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote. Default: the project estimate value.

note.description: Note shown next to the item in the shopping list.

role.description: anchor: wall fixings. A tall object needs one to pass the tip-over check.

spool.description: Grams of filament in one spool.

packName.description: Name of one spool, for example "1 kg spool".

price.description: Price of one spool in the project currency.

density.description: Filament density in g/cm³: PLA 1.24, PETG 1.27, ABS 1.04.

fill.description: Share of the solid part volume that the printer fills (walls and infill), from 0 to 1.

rate.description: Grams of filament the printer lays down in one hour.

spare.description: Spare share from 0 to 1 (failed prints, purge).

spec.description: Size or type, for example "fine blade, 40 teeth".

have.description: true: you have it. It shows in the plan only.

get.description: How to get it when you do not have it.

price.description: Price to buy, or price for one day to rent.

store.description: Id of the store in stores.

power.description: true: a power tool. Each step that uses it needs a WARNING.

ppe.description: true: protective equipment, listed in the Safety group.

est.description: Set false when the price is a real quote.

part.description: A part: one piece that is cut, made or installed.

label.description: Letter the reader sees, shared by identical parts. Default: the id.

name.description: One word used for the part everywhere, for example "Side".

material.description: Id of its material in materials.

size.description: Box size [x, y, z] in project units, before rotation.

at.description: Minimum corner [x, y, z] of the box before rotation. The guide needs it.

shape.description: box, or cylinder (two equal sides are the diameter).

rotate.description: Rotation in degrees about the box centre, x then y then z.

color.description: Color in 3D. Default: the material color.

rip.description: true: the part may be narrower than the board width (a rip cut).

grain.description: Grain on a sheet with grain: along (default), across or any.

role.description: anchor: a wall fixing for the tip-over check.

finish.description: false: leave the part out of the finished area.

joins.description: Parts this part may overlap on purpose (a shelf in a dado).

print.description: Slicer numbers of a 3D-printed part (a part of a printed material). A missing value is estimated from the size.

grams.description: Filament for one part in grams, from the slicer.

hours.description: Printer time for one part in hours, from the slicer.

settings.description: Print settings for the reader, for example "0.2 mm layers, 20% infill, no supports".

prop.description: A context box (wall, bench, floor). Never bought.

size.description: Box size [x, y, z] in project units.

at.description: Minimum corner [x, y, z]. The guide needs it.

rotate.description: Rotation in degrees, x then y then z.

hero.description: true: shown in the Plan view.

name.description: Card title, for example "Cut on the line".

why.description: Why the technique works, in STE descriptive sentences.

fastener.description: A fastener: positional { material, at, dir } (drawn in 3D) or counted { material, count } (not drawn).

dir.description: Direction the fastener travels [dx, dy, dz].

repeat.description: Repeat the fastener: count copies, each moved by step.

count.description: Number of fasteners, the first one included.

step.description: Offset [dx, dy, dz] from one fastener to the next.

finish.description: A finish: coats of an amount material on parts.

material.description: Id of an amount material with coverage.

parts.description: Parts to finish. Default: every part not made of an each material, except finish: false.

step.description: One build step: one visible change.

title.description: A command, for example "Attach the top shelf".

phase.description: Phase name. Consecutive steps with one name form a phase.

minutes.description: Work time for an experienced person, in minutes.

parts.description: Parts installed in this step. Each part is installed in exactly one step.

uses.description: Consumables used in this step: { materialId: amount }.

cuts.description: true, or material ids: stock is cut in this step.

prints.description: true, or printed material ids: the printer makes those parts in this step. Their printer time is waiting time of the step.

do.description: Instructions in STE, one action each.

items.description: An instruction, or { t, new: true } for a line shown only at First time.

new.description: true: show the line only at First time.

check.description: The inspection that ends the step.

why.description: Why, in STE descriptive sentences. Shown at First time.

tip.description: A tip. Shown at First time and Some experience.

pose.description: kit: lay the cut parts flat on the floor.

focus.description: Parts lit in the kit pose.

from.description: Path [dx, dy, dz] the new parts arrive along.

az.description: Azimuth in degrees: 0 front, 90 right side, 180 back.

note.description: A short note under the 3D view, shown at every level; never in print, plan.md or the no-script copy. For example "The picture shows the cube upright."

props.description: Prop ids shown in this step.
